sources.label: Totti's Bondi Private Dining Room — Merivale

blocks.text: The short version: the surest way to score a table at Totti's Bondi is to book online through Merivale the moment the calendar opens, and to stay flexible on your day and time — but if you've left it late, same-day walk-ins are genuinely welcome, and cancellations pop up online all the time. I've talked friends and visitors through this reservation more times than I can count, so here's exactly how I'd go about it, without the midnight stress.

Totti's sits inside The Royal Bondi on Bondi Road, a short stroll up from the sand, and it has become one of those Sydney rooms everyone wants a piece of — sun-warmed, loud in the best way, and built around that famous woodfired bread. That popularity is exactly why a little planning goes a long way.

items.label: Where
items.value: Inside The Royal Bondi, 283 Bondi Road, Bondi

items.label: Style
items.value: Share-style Italian; the bread is non-negotiable

blocks.text: Booking online: the reliable way in

Reservations run through Merivale's own booking system on the Totti's venue page — that's the one platform I'd point anyone to. Tables are released a set window ahead of time, so the trick is simply to be ready when your date first becomes available rather than trying weeks later once the prime slots are gone. Because that release window can change, I'd open the booking calendar, scroll to the furthest bookable date, and work backwards from there rather than trusting a number you read on a blog.

items: Jump on the booking page the day your date opens — lunch and prime dinner slots go fast.
Have your details (name, phone, card if requested) ready so you're not fumbling as tables vanish.
Set a phone reminder for the morning the window opens, then book first, deliberate later — you can always adjust.

blocks.text: Keep a browser tab on the Totti's booking page even after you've missed out for your ideal night. Totti's is a largely outdoor venue, so when Bondi's weather turns, last-minute cancellations reappear online — I've grabbed a Saturday table on the Thursday before simply by refreshing at the right moment.
Be flexible — it's your biggest advantage

If you can bend on timing, the whole thing gets easier. An earlier lunch or a later dinner sitting is far more likely to have space than the 7pm-on-a-Saturday sweet spot everyone else is chasing. Midweek is calmer than the weekend, and smaller groups of two or three slot in where a table of eight simply won't. None of this is a secret — it's just how a busy room breathes.

blocks.title: Larger groups and special occasions
blocks.text: Big tables, birthdays and set-menu events work differently from a regular booking, and Totti's has a private dining option too. For anything beyond a standard table, contact the venue directly on +61 2 9114 7371 or use the enquiry form on Totti's private dining page rather than the standard online booking.
No booking? You still have options

Don't write off a spontaneous visit. Same-day walk-ins are welcome at Totti's, with a limited number of tables held back each day — your odds are best if you turn up early rather than at peak, keep the group small, and are happy to perch wherever they can seat you. A weekday afternoon is your friend here. And if it's genuinely last-minute, a quick phone call the morning of can turn up a cancellation the website hasn't caught up with yet.
Book if you can, walk in if you can't, and either way — order the bread.

One last piece of honesty: opening hours, menus and the exact booking window all shift from season to season, so before you build a whole day around it, check the current details on the official Totti's page. Get the reservation sorted, arrive a touch early to soak up the courtyard buzz, and the hard part's done.

items.q: How do I book a table at Totti's Bondi?
items.a: Through Merivale's online booking system on the Totti's venue page (merivale.com/venues/tottis). You can also phone the venue on +61 2 9114 7371. Booking online is the most reliable route for a standard table.

items.q: How far in advance do bookings open?
items.a: Tables are released a set window ahead of your date, and that window can change over time. Rather than trusting a fixed number, open the booking calendar, scroll to the furthest date you can select, and plan to book the moment your date first appears.
Yes — same-day walk-in guests are welcome, with a limited number of tables held for them. Arrive early rather than at peak, keep your group small, and you'll give yourself the best shot.

items.q: What should I do if I can't get a table for the night I want?
items.a: Keep watching the online booking page — Totti's is largely outdoor, so cancellations reappear when the weather turns. You can also call the venue on the day to ask about no-shows and last-minute openings.
Inside The Royal Bondi at 283 Bondi Road, Bondi, a short walk up from the beach. Check the official Merivale page for current opening hours before you go, as they change seasonally.
